title: Americans' Use of Social Media in 2026

facts.fact: The National Public Opinion Reference Survey included 5,511 U.S. adults.
facts.quote: This analysis is based on findings from the National Public Opinion Reference Survey, a Center survey of 5,511 U.S. adults.

facts.fact: The 2026 survey was conducted from January 30 to June 18, 2026.
The overall margin of error for the 2026 survey is plus or minus 1.8 percentage points.
facts.quote: Its overall margin of error is plus or minus 1.8 percentage points.

facts.fact: YouTube and Facebook are the most widely used social media platforms in the United States, according to Pew.
facts.quote: YouTube and Facebook are the most widely used social media platforms in the United States.

facts.fact: In the June 2026 Pew survey, 84% of U.S. adults said they ever use YouTube.
In the June 2025 Pew survey, 8% of U.S. adults said they ever use Threads.
In the 2026 Pew survey, the poll was conducted via web, mail and phone.
facts.quote: In 2024 through 2026, the poll was conducted via web, mail and phone.
